findings.finding: Required native worker role can bypass basename filter
findings.evidence: Both v2 auditors accept required worker/capture exe=/tmp/untrusted-host with zero hash because unknown basename is skipped. Require selected dotnet identity by worker PID/role.

findings.finding: Control wrapper exits while launcher group survives
findings.evidence: Driver teardown is conditional on wrapper.poll() is None. Receipt-write failure can leave launcher alive after wrapper exit. Drain the owned private wrapper session independent of leader status.
